baseline_gate_overview.interpretation: A strict cell can fail because one seed crosses a point-estimate threshold even when the cell-mean CI remains below that threshold.

claim_guardrail: Schedule effects do not by themselves localize compensation to QK, OV, FFN, or readout; pointwise intervals are targeted exploratory evidence, not independent-seed confirmatory inference or an open-problem claim.
